title: Geometric and stochastic framework for a regularized $p(x)$-Laplacian
summary: For a prescribed classical profile and a fixed positive regularization parameter, we construct an Itô diffusion whose interior generator reproduces the regularized $p(x)$-Laplacian when applied to that profile. We determine the exact tangent spectra of the unregularized and regularized fluxes, characterize their behavior at zero gradient, and establish quantitative ellipticity bounds on bounded gradient ranges.
